description: MCP bridge between AI CLI tools (Claude Code) and the VS Code debugger — set breakpoints, control execution, inspect variables, all from your terminal.

ideCodeDebug.port.description: Starting port for the MCP server (localhost only)

ideCodeDebug.portRange.description: Number of ports to try starting from the base port. Set to 1 to disable auto-scanning.

ideCodeDebug.portRetries.description: Number of retry attempts per port before moving to the next one

ideCodeDebug.maxRequestBodyMB.description: Maximum allowed request body size in megabytes. Protects the extension host from oversized payloads.

ideCodeDebug.allowedPaths.description: Glob patterns restricting which files the MCP tools can access (e.g. ["/home/me/projects/**", "/tmp/**"]). Empty means no restriction — all files accessible to VS Code are allowed.

ideCodeDebug.autoStart.description: Automatically start the MCP server when VS Code opens
